reason: Running provider goals must return each replayable required completion-hook rejection to the model until the hook accepts or the goal stops. Blocking start-hook output must also reach the model in goal mode without bypassing the gate. Selected cases cover repeated completion failures, ordinary-turn bounds, effectful-hook no-replay safety, and start-hook delivery. Tool-free goal retries also assert exact provider usage accounting.
exclusions: No UI, browser-origin, frontend, or native source changed, so those layers are empty. The selected Python cases cover the changed Core hook lifecycle; unrelated chat and provider suites are excluded. Production real-Core exercise would require a controlled provider and hook workspace and is not run against active Eve research.
